races.name: Coral Goodwood Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
The inaugural running of this marathon contest using stalls with VALIANCY making plenty of appeal. Successful on return at Hamilton, he very much caught the eye when sixth in the Copper Horse at Royal Ascot in June, keeping on well having been asked to come from a long way back (also widest of all). He earns the vote with potential for better still over this longer trip. Ascot Stakes second Defiantly and Highwind head a strong Irish challenge, whilst Believitanducan is another holding claims.

  1. VALIANCY (IRE)
  2. DEFIANTLY (FR)
  3. HIGHWIND (FR)

races.name: HKJC World Pool Thoroughbred Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
TALK OF NEW YORK posted a fine first effort at Group 1 level when third to Bow Echo in the St James's Palace Stakes at Royal Ascot last month so Charlie Appleby's colt is expected to prove a tough nut to crack dropped into Group 3 company. A step up to 1m and/or first-time blinkers may elicit further progress from Saber Strike, so he heads up the opposition, with Yazin rounding off the shortlist having been progressive prior to shaping as if amiss last time.

  1. TALK OF NEW YORK
  2. SABER STRIKE (IRE)
  3. YAZIN

races.name: Coral Golden Mile (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
The form of BEAGLE BAY's Sandown win last month is solid and a further 5 lb rise may not stop him with further progress likely. Stall 18 has the potential to make life awkward for Scoville but he was a big eyecatcher in the Hunt Cup at Royal Ascot and can play a leading role if Tom Marquand can manoeuvre him into a good position. Tribal Chief, Indalo, and Ebt's Guard all have low draws and merit respect. Cerulean Bay's Goodwood record also earns him a place on the shortlist.

  1. BEAGLE BAY (FR)
  2. SCOVILLE
  3. TRIBAL CHIEF (FR)

races.name: King George Qatar Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
NIGHT RAIDER has been rejuvenated by a gelding operation this season and he may well be good enough to defy a penalty here. This test could bring out the best in Jakajaro and he rates a serious threat, while Rumstar also has the form to go close.

  1. NIGHT RAIDER (IRE)
  2. JAKAJARO (IRE)
  3. RUMSTAR

races.name: Regent Seven Seas Cruises Bentinck Conditions Stakes
races.verdict:
GALEN has been a fine money-spinner for these connections and the form of his recent Wolferton fourth should see him go close again. Haatem beat the selection in last season's Wolferton and can pose a major threat, his finishing position at Royal Ascot down to bad luck rather than bad form, whilst Boiling Point already has a listed win here to his name this season and can be in the mix.

  1. GALEN
  2. HAATEM (IRE)
  3. BOILING POINT (IRE)

races.name: Hawes & Curtis Nursery
races.verdict:
DUBAI CHAMPION is very much going the right way, and he can land this valuable nursery under Ryan Moore. Improving pair Innichen and The Dancing Pirate appeal most of the other lower-drawn runners, while the abundance of pace among the high numbers should bring Clash Of Hearts firmly into the mix.

  1. DUBAI CHAMPION (IRE)
  2. INNICHEN (ITY)
  3. THE DANCING PIRATE

races.name: World Pool Bet With The Tote Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Having progressed with each of his first 3 starts, INTO THE LIGHT had excuses at Royal Ascot last time so he remains capable of better with his yard going well. He gets the vote ahead of Astracornus, who remains capable of better as he goes up in trip, with Pierian also one to note as she makes her handicap debut.

  1. INTO THE LIGHT
  2. ASTRACORNUS
  3. PIERIAN

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
The unexposed SILVER LAKE pulled a long way clear with the runner-up to make a winning start in handicaps and a small rise may not be enough to stop her from following up. Zgharta hasn't had much luck of late but should be thereabouts if getting the rub of the green, with the progressive Room Fourteen likely to be in the mix also.

  1. SILVER LAKE
  2. ZGHARTA (IRE)
  3. ROOM FOURTEEN

races.name: Big Stage Hire Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
Lightly-raced 3-y-o BUMAAN is in good hands, and he may improve to deny Belle of KT a quick-fire double.

  1. BUMAAN
  2. BELLE OF KT
  3. SEA OF CHARM (FR)

races.name: Trusted Betting Site Reviews gambling.com British EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TRICKY JENNY is weighted to reverse last month's near miss behind Sheer Beauty and she gets the vote in an open-looking novice. Northern raider Havana Gift is feared most, with Texas Crown also respected.

  1. TRICKY JENNY
  2. HAVANA GIFT
  3. TEXAS CROWN

races.name: Bath Rum And Reggae Race Night 15th August Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
JACKIE BROWN has made a positive start for the Adrian Wintle yard and can strike under Finley Marsh. Some Nightmare has held his form pretty well of late and is second choice ahead of Rogue Rebellion.

  1. JACKIE BROWN (IRE)
  2. SOME NIGHTMARE (IRE)
  3. ROGUE REBELLION

races.name: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
HONKY TONK GIRL sets the standard following a much-improved performance at Nottingham last time. Elmfield would appeal if supported, while Nzuri should be in the hunt for the places.

  1. HONKY TONK GIRL
  2. ELMFIELD (IRE)
  3. NZURI

races.name: Thank You To Great Western Air Ambulance Handicap
races.verdict:
CONNIE'S ROSE has given her running more often than not this campaign and is taken to defy top weight at the chief expense of Candy Warhol.

  1. CONNIE'S ROSE
  2. CANDY WARHOL (USA)
  3. BEERWAH (IRE)

races.name: Great Western Air Ambulance Handicap
races.verdict:
MISS COLETTE is bred to be much better than her lowly opening mark and can provide Sir Mark Prescott with another winning handicap debutante. Blue Hero arrives in good form and has a positive course record, so rates as the main danger.

  1. MISS COLETTE
  2. BLUE HERO (CAN)
  3. RACING DEMON

races.name: Edinburgh Childrens Hospital Charity Handicap
races.verdict:
JEDHI KNIGHT stepped up on his return when finding only one too strong at Pontefract earlier in the month and having been nudged up just 1 lb, Paul Midgley's 4-y-o is fancied to go one better at the expense of Sophiesticate, who has gradually found her feet for new connections. Falaise Blanc may prove best of the remainder.

  1. JEDHI KNIGHT
  2. SOPHIESTICATE (IRE)
  3. FALAISE BLANC (FR)

races.name: EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GERRY'S DARLING took a step forward when finishing runner-up at Redcar just under a fortnight ago and having been found a weak-looking maiden, Roger Fell's filly is selected to go one better at the expense of Hey Up Ronnie, who can build on his promising debut effort at the second attempt. Nosey Book can fill out third.

  1. GERRY'S DARLING
  2. HEY UP RONNIE
  3. NOSEY BOOK

races.name: Bernard Hunter Mobile Cranes Nursery
races.verdict:
AMANTHA seemed to be caught out by the stiff finish at Beverley having looked in command for most of the way and can get her head back in front returned to the scene of her selling success. Bigalo was second off this mark at Catterick last month and is second choice ahead of Tiger In The Tree, who was a place behind the selection at Beverley.

  1. AMANTHA (IRE)
  2. BIGALO
  3. TIGER IN THE TREE

races.name: Bernard Hunter Metal Recycling Handicap
races.verdict:
Four of the 5 runners have tasted C&D success. MONTEZUMA hasn't finished out of the first 2 in his 4 previous C&D visits and is taken to bounce back to form with a bang and prove too strong for last year's winner Curious Rover. Sole 3-y-o Mighty Magnus shaped quite well at Newmarket last time and should also be on the premises.

  1. MONTEZUMA
  2. CURIOUS ROVER (IRE)
  3. MIGHTY MAGNUS (IRE)

races.name: East Air Conditioning Handicap
races.verdict:
A repeat of the form WAIT FOR IT showed when second at Catterick last week might be good enough to see her break her maiden at the 14th time of asking. Braes of Doune could be spot on for this after a pair of comeback outings at Ayr in recent weeks and is second choice having dipped to his last winning mark.

  1. WAIT FOR IT (IRE)
  2. BRAES OF DOUNE
  3. MONHAMMER

races.name: Lens Self Storage Handicap
races.verdict:
GALLUS NORMAN is by far the least exposed of these and can continue his progression back over a C&D he's already recorded a win over. Jim Goldie's other runner, Cascade Hall, may prove his biggest threat, while Inappropriate will be a threat if staying this longer trip.

  1. GALLUS NORMAN
  2. CASCADE HALL (IRE)
  3. INAPPROPRIATE (IRE)

races.name: Graham + Sibbald And Neilsons Handicap
races.verdict:
THORNABY PEARL won at Hamilton Park 20 days ago and that form has been franked by the runner-up winning since so he could follow up at the expense of Golden Havana, who is in excellent form with 3 seconds to his name. Wee Mary goes well here so could secure a place.

  1. THORNABY PEARL
  2. GOLDEN HAVANA (IRE)
  3. WEE MARY (IRE)

races.name: Zyn In-The-Moment EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Charlie Appleby has a 42% strike-rate with his 2-y-os this year so NATIONAL HONOUR is taken to make a winning debut, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Hayate is another newcomer who makes obvious appeal, while Sexy Chick failed to stay 7f at the July Meeting and was only just touched off on her C&D debut prior to that.

  1. NATIONAL HONOUR (IRE)
  2. HAYATE (IRE)
  3. SEXY CHICK

races.name: Zyn Pacesetter Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Preference is for ALEATRIX who made a promising start when scoring in good style in a Salisbury maiden last month. She is taken to build on that first experience and make it 2 from 2, though Without Prejudice boasts an excellent pedigree and isn't taken lightly on debut.

  1. ALEATRIX
  2. WITHOUT PREJUDICE (IRE)
  3. LA MARIPOSA

races.name: Zyn Pole Position Handicap
races.verdict:
ROBERT ANSTRUTHER had plenty to spare at Nottingham and is taken make light of a 7 lb rise and deny Jimmy Knocker a second successive win in this race. Spring Bloom's good C&D record suggests he's likely to be on the premises again, while market support for James Owen's new recruit Blue Samuna would make her a potential threat to all.

  1. ROBERT ANSTRUTHER
  2. JIMMY KNOCKER (IRE)
  3. SPRING BLOOM

races.name: Zyn Frontrunner Handicap
races.verdict:
NIKOVO's latest C&D third received a boost at Goodwood on Wednesday and he can strike from his lower turf mark. Exposure was a place behind the selection last time and may provide the chief threat ahead of C&D specialist Where's Freddy.

  1. NIKOVO
  2. EXPOSURE
  3. WHERE'S FREDDY (IRE)

races.name: Zyn Frontrunner Finish Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
This can go the way of SIBLING RIVELRY, who did well under the circumstances when making a winning reappearance at Windsor and is now back into class 5 company for the first time since. The biggest threat could come from Society Girl after she returned to form at Epsom on her latest outing.

  1. SIBLING RIVELRY
  2. SOCIETY GIRL
  3. DANCE TIME

races.name: Zyn Strong Stride Handicap
races.verdict:
MERTOUN has proved a different proposition switched to handicaps over this trip, making it back-to-back wins with a wide-margin success at Carlisle, and can continue his progress to score again. Drifts Away is much respected, though, arriving on the back of a career-best victory at Yarmouth, with Born A Rebel also considered.

  1. MERTOUN (FR)
  2. DRIFTS AWAY
  3. BORN A REBEL

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RAJBA shaped well with a view to dropping back to this trip when sixth in a Newbury handicap (1m) 2 weeks ago and earns the vote back in maiden company. Gilding The Lily is a most interesting newcomer for John & Thady Gosden and market confidence behind her would look significant. Foxy Night is another with obvious form claims.

  1. RAJIBA
  2. GILDING THE LILY
  3. FOXY NIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
ANGEL'S SHARE finds herself 3 lb below the mark she defied when a wide-margin winner on all-weather last summer and, having posted easily her most encouraging effort this year at Yarmouth 23 days ago, she could be worth chancing to get back to winning ways. Kit Gabriel back at 7f from a handy mark and Southwell scorer Gunfighter are others high on the shortlist.

  1. ANGELS' SHARE
  2. KIT GABRIEL (IRE)
  3. GUNFIGHTER (IRE)

races.name: Call 01902 390016 To Name A Race Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
GHISA caught the eye on her handicap debut/return at Southwell last time and looks the one to be with. Paris Babe could be interesting dropped in class, with Bella Bisbee and Carnival of Light others to consider in a competitive race.

  1. GHISA (IRE)
  2. PARIS BABE (FR)
  3. BELLA BISBEE

races.name: Thank You, Jane Broad, For All Your Support Handicap
races.verdict:
This should be run to suit HIGHLAND SHAH, who's fancied to resume winning ways over a longer trip. Improving Suggy is feared most, while India Gold's most recent form puts her right in the mix.

  1. HIGHLAND SHAH (FR)
  2. SUGGY
  3. INDIA GOLD (IRE)

races.name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap
races.verdict:
ROC DE FER has been typically well campaigned by Sir Mark Prescott, and he can follow up last week's success at Southwell. Jodhpur Blue could be the one to chase him home if back in the form he showed over the spring, with Much a likely improver on handicap bow.

  1. ROC DE FER (IRE)
  2. JODHPUR BLUE (FR)
  3. MUCH

races.name: Cavani Fashion Forward Handicap
races.verdict:
AMERICAN STYLE has run well in some better contests from a higher mark and looks well treated to open his account for the season on the back of an encouraging recent effort. Course specialist King of Chaos heads the list of dangers from the consistent Papa Cocktail.

  1. AMERICAN STYLE
  2. KING OF CHAOS (IRE)
  3. PAPA COCKTAIL (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
A thin race and recent Ayr scorer SIXCOR gets the vote. Fancy Dancer and Poetic Jack are feared most.

  1. SIXCOR
  2. FANCY DANCER
  3. POETIC JACK

races.name: Kids Eat For 1 Pound At The Border Minstrel This Summer Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
The in-form INSPIRING SPEECHES appeals as the most solid option, though veterans Balqaa and Arranmore are both capable if things drop right.

  1. INSPIRING SPEECHES (IRE)
  2. BALQAA
  3. ARRANMORE

races.name: Harry Potter Droneart Show Novice Stakes
races.verdict:
Impressive debut winner SIOUXPERB can get back on track having found the Coventry at Royal Ascot too demanding. Sonic Angel, Royal Strike and St Helier are 3 interesting newcomers and the betting should reveal more.

  1. SIOUXPERB
  2. SONIC ANGEL
  3. ROYAL STRIKE (IRE)

races.name: quinnbet.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Last year's winner STAND STRONG gets the vote back on all-weather but this does look competitive with 4-y-os Chambers and Time Turner still getting better.

  1. STAND STRONG
  2. CHAMBERS (IRE)
  3. TIME TURNER

races.name: QuinnBet Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
TAAKLAM proved too free in a small field at Catterick when last seen in May but had previously been in good form and is worth another chance back on all-weather after a break. Brave Traveller is a danger, while Go Lockers Go could also be involved.

  1. TAAKLAM (IRE)
  2. BRAVE TRAVELLER
  3. GO LOCKERS GO

races.name: QuinnBet Extra Place Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Successful 3 times on all-weather last year, REGINALD CHARLES shaped as if still in good form this season at Beverley on his latest outing, so he gets the vote back on this surface. Jamaican Storm and Judicature have both eased to workable marks and make up the shortlist.

  1. REGINALD CHARLES
  2. JAMAICAN STORM
  3. JUDICATURE

races.name: QuinnBet Extra Place Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
FINN IRONSIDE has a C&D win from this mark to his name and recent efforts have been solid enough to think he'll go well here. Travis and War And Love are closely matched on recent form and both should go well again.

  1. FINN IRONSIDE
  2. TRAVIS
  3. WAR AND LOVE

races.name: Harry Potter Droneart Show Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
MATERIAL GIRL offered a bit more than previously when fourth in a strong-looking novice at Leicester last time and she could yet do better switched to this grade. She is preferred ahead of Uncle Sam, who remains lightly raced for his current yard, with Long Shot also considered.

  1. MATERIAL GIRL
  2. UNCLE SAM
  3. LONG SHOT

races.name: James's Gate Irish EBF Median Auction Maiden
races.verdict:
OTHERWORLDLY has a handy draw and looks the one to beat on return to maiden company. Ischgl is weighted to go close, while there could be better to come from Joga Bonito and Mirren.

  1. OTHERWORLDLY (IRE)
  2. ISCHGL (IRE)
  3. JOGA BONITO

races.name: Guinness Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
Preference is for the lightly-raced VICAR STREET, who finished third in a Punchestown maiden on his seasonal/chasing debut despite racing too freely. With that run behind him, he is taken to open his account in this sphere at the expense of stablemate Ocastle Des Mottes, while Ballystone could go well on his chasing bow.

  1. VICAR STREET (IRE)
  2. OCASTLE DES MOTTES (FR)
  3. BALLYSTONE (IRE)

races.name: Guinness Galway Blazers Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
CHARLIE LUCIANO got back on track after a lengthy spell in the doldrums when winning a maiden chase at Kilbeggan 3 weeks ago and he's on a good mark if able to reproduce that performance back in a handicap. Rexem and Antrim Coast head the dangers.

  1. CHARLIE LUCIANO (IRE)
  2. REXEM (IRE)
  3. ANTRIM COAST (IRE)

races.name: Guinness Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
A competitive handicap with several having claims. Preference is for Willie Mullins' THREAD OF GOLD, who has few miles on the clock and is open to improvement, particularly now trying this longer trip. Fixation may do best of the remainder from Touch The Moon, with Port Of Spain another to consider back down in grade.

  1. THREAD OF GOLD (IRE)
  2. FIXATION (IRE)
  3. TOUCH THE MOON (IRE)

races.name: Guinness Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
A huge field but only a handful of these make any serious appeal, ZADAWA selected to make it third time lucky with this step up to 1½m sure to be in her favour. A first-time hood goes on, and she can get the better of Cosmetic, who is progressing gradually and found just one too strong at Fairyhouse earlier in the month. Porters Corner, Pleased and Stellar Moment can fight out minor honours.

  1. ZADAWA (FR)
  2. COSMETIC (IRE)
  3. PORTERS CORNER (FR)

races.name: Arthur Guinness Handicap
races.verdict:
AQUILLA STAR ran really well when collared late at Ballinrobe 11 days ago and a repeat performance should see her go close. Tharaka is a very interesting handicap debutant having joined the Emmet Mullins yard, whilst JP's Express is also interesting on the back of his fast-finishing Fairyhouse third.

  1. AQUILLA STAR (IRE)
  2. THARAKA (IRE)
  3. JP'S EXPRESS (IRE)

races.name: Hop House 13 Handicap
races.verdict:
LADY PLIMSOLL shaped well when second over 2m at Dundalk in December and this step back up in trip should suit given that effort. Vantage Code has shown improved form in handicaps recently, staying on well when third earlier in the week, while Espritroyale ran her best race at Down Royal in June and is bred to appreciate this longer trip.

  1. LADY PLIMSOLL (IRE)
  2. VANTAGE CODE (IRE)
  3. ESPRITROYALE (IRE)

races.name: Rockshore Refreshingly Irish Race
races.verdict:
UXMAL clearly isn't the easiest to train given his infrequent appearances, yet he confirmed he retains plenty of ability on the back of an 8-month absence when third in listed company at Limerick in June. He holds obvious claims and is fancied to capitalise. Galileo Dame, the selection's stablemate may emerge as the chief threat. Teed Up and Taipan, a dual winner of this race, also can't be discounted.

  1. UXMAL (IRE)
  2. GALILEO DAME (IRE)
  3. TEED UP (IRE)

races.name: Prix Du Rocher De La Vierge Claiming Stakes
Prix Henri Et Hector Du Poy Handicap
Grand Handicap De Biarritz-association Des Proprietaires Du Sud-ouest Handicap
Px Du Gpmt Des Artisans De St-aignan-s-roe - C. De Haies De Senonnes Hurdle
Prix Super U Pouance (px De Pouance) Hurdle
Prix De La Commune De Senonnes Stakes
Prix Du Groupe Pigeon (prix Des Andegaves) Stakes
Prix Commune D'ombree D'anjou (prix De Pouance) Maiden Stakes
